title: 第2章 很简单，他哭就是了
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

当柜子被

哆啦A梦。

和记忆中没有偏差，一模一样。

看来，哆啦A梦已经住在柜子里了。

此时哆啦A梦打了个哈欠，睡眼惺忪的看向林远。

“大雄，你怎么才回来，不是说好要一起打扫卫生的吗？”

“要不不然妈妈回来会生气的哦！”

林远眯着眼睛，看向哆啦A梦的脑袋。

没有耳朵。

【规则六：没有耳朵的哆啦A梦是你最好的朋友，你不能拒绝他的任何请求。】

所以，林远必须和哆啦A梦一起打扫卫生。

哆啦A梦见林远迟迟不说话，它咧开嘴，森笑的盯着林远。

紧接着。

它从柜子里跳了下来，一步一步迈向林远。

“你怎么不说话啊，你是大雄吗？”

哆啦A梦渐渐从蓝色变成黑色，眼睛猩红的看向林远，口水不自觉的流下。

似乎就像是看到了...一道美食。

龙国怪谈指挥中心内，所有人的心都提到了嗓子眼。

“看样子这个诡异是和主角在同一间卧室休息的，这也太难了！”

“唉，到底是年轻人，已经被诡异吓傻了，对面的诡异都产生诡异化了。”

“这家伙到底是什么，为什么像个机器人，现在诡异都产高科技了？！”

“不知道，但我知道龙国要输了。”

所有人都不看好林远，毕竟沉默可是怪谈游戏里最致命的错误。

除非林远现在能找到破局的办法，不然诡异化后的诡异，会直接吃了天选者，终结挑战。

方圆一脸担忧的盯着光幕，垂下头叹了口气。

“如果能顺着时间长河逆流而上，我希望回到怪诞游戏降临前，至少那样我还能享受生活。”

忽然，一道声音在怪谈指挥中心响起。

“方指挥长，丑国的天选者已经做出了选择！”

所有人屏住呼吸，盯向丑国直播的光幕。

如果丑国的天选者能安然度过，他们就能在第一时间告知林远，让他做出正确的选择。

还有机会！

虽然每天只能向天选者提示一次，但总好比刚开局就结束！

怪谈指挥中心内所有人手心冒汗，额头上不断的冒出细珠，内心狂跳。

一定要...快点啊。

天选者杰克看到哆啦A梦后没有犹豫，反而是肉笑皮不笑的打起了招呼。

“哆啦A梦，你怎么睡在那里？”

身为私家侦探的他，一眼就断定出眼前的机器人是规则里的哆啦A梦。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When the cabinet is

Doraemon.

There is no deviation from the memory, exactly the same.

It seems that Doraemon is already living in the cupboard.

At this time, Doraemon yawned and looked at Lin Yuan sleepily.

"Nobita, why did you come back? Didn't you agree to clean up together?"

"Otherwise, mom will be angry when she comes back!"

Lin Yuan squinted his eyes and looked at Doraemon's head.

No ears.

[Rule 6: Doraemon without ears is your best friend, and you cannot refuse any of his requests.】

Therefore, Lin Yuan must clean the house with Doraemon.

Doraemon saw that Lin Yuan had not spoken for a long time. He grinned and stared at Lin Yuan with a smile.

Immediately afterwards.

It jumped down from the cabinet and walked towards Lin Yuan step by step.

"Why don't you speak? Are you Nobita?"

Doraemon gradually turned from blue to black, looking at Lin Yuan with scarlet eyes, and his saliva flowed down unconsciously.

It seemed like I was seeing... a delicacy.

In the Dragon Kingdom Ghost Story command center, everyone's hearts were in their throats.

"It seems that this weirdo is resting in the same bedroom as the protagonist. This is too difficult!"

"Well, after all, it is a young man who has been frightened by the weirdness, and the weirdness on the opposite side has become weird."

"What on earth is this guy? Why does he look like a robot? Now it's weird and high-tech?!"

"I don't know, but I know that Dragon Kingdom is going to lose."

Everyone is not optimistic about Lin Yuan. After all, silence is the most fatal mistake in the Kaitan game.

Unless Lin Yuan can find a way to break the situation now, the strange Weiyi will directly eat the chosen one and end the challenge.

Fangyuan stared at the light screen with a worried look, lowered his head and sighed.

"If I could go up the river of time, I would like to go back to before the weird games came. At least then I could still enjoy life."

Suddenly, a voice sounded in the Kaitan command center.

"Commander Fang, the Chosen One of Chou Country has made his choice!"

Everyone held their breath and stared at the light screen of Chou Country's live broadcast.

If the chosen ones of Chou Country can survive safely, they can tell Lin Yuan as soon as possible and let him make the right choice.

There's still a chance!

Although you can only prompt the Chosen One once a day, it's like it's over just as it started!

Everyone in the Kaitan Command Center had sweaty palms, beads of blood on their foreheads, and their hearts were beating wildly.

Must... hurry up.

Jack, the Chosen One, did not hesitate when he saw Doraemon. Instead, he greeted him with a smile.

"Doraemon, why are you sleeping there?"

As a private detective, he determined at a glance that the robot in front of him was Doraemon in the rules.
